thread:
Sara Chen: quick heads-up — Novapulse just filed a formal onboarding request for a custom 13B to run in Private (VPC). They need KMS/HSM, PHI-safe handling, and a safety/regression eval before we flip traffic. Ping @Mike Patel and @Leo Rodrigues to scope infra + rollout. They're worried about renewal if latency >250ms or hallucination rate >2%.

Mike Patel: on it. can you paste the model artifact details (framework, file layout, quantized?) and the eval corpus link? also any compliance paperwork?

Sara Chen: artifact: s3://novapulse/models/novapulse-13b-v1.tar.gz. Model exported from PyTorch/transformers, they asked for 4-bit quantization variant but also want baseline float32 for comparison. They explicitly requested Redwood-managed HSM (customer prefers we host to meet timelines). Eval corpus: s3://novapulse/evals/clinical_v1.tar.gz (2k prompts + labels). CRM: account health = yellow, renewal flagged as at-risk if infra/perf not competitive.

Leo Rodrigues: we can deploy in Private, but need to confirm GPU class. For 13B quantized 4-bit we can do A10G or RTX class; H100/A100 preferred for baseline float variant. Staging recommendation: 2x A100 for preprod canary, then 1x A10G for baseline private instance to save cost. note: hosted HSM option adds ~2 weeks onboarding if customer insists on third-party HSM integration.

Anya Volkov: I'll run the safety and regression suites. please ensure the eval corpus includes golden labels and hallucination probes. I use safety-check v3 + rouge/factuality heuristics. upload to shared path or grant access to the s3 bucket.

Sara Chen: granted cross-account read: s3://novapulse/evals/clinical_v1.tar.gz. added a small hallucination prompt set under /hallucination_checks/ (200 items). Also attached their desired SLOs in the request: p50 < 200ms, safety-fail < 2%, cost per 1k tok under $4 equivalent.

Mike Patel: proposal: canary rollout behind routing policy + A/B test. plan sketch below — I'll formalize in the rollout doc by EOD.

```
routing:
  - variant: quantized-4bit
    traffic: 10%
  - variant: baseline-fp32
    traffic: 90%
metrics: [p50_latency_ms, safety_fail_rate, token_cost]
duration: 48h
rollout_checks:
  - safety_fail_rate < 2%
  - p50_latency < 250ms
  - no increase in fatal errors
```

Leo Rodrigues: sounds good. two operational notes: 1) for Private we need customer sign-off on data retention + syslog/trace config (they must accept Redwood defaults or we lock to customer VPC logging). 2) If they want our managed HSM, legal needs to clear the addendum — that can be fast if CS sends the template.

Sara Chen: customer already said they prefer Redwood-managed HSM to keep timeline. I'll send the HSM addendum template to legal and CC support. Also scheduling: they asked for an enablement runbook session next Tue 10am PT — that works for them.

Anya Volkov: I'll join the enablement call to walk the eval corpus and expected failure modes. planning to run first pass safety/regression within 72h after I get access.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-7829 — novapulse 13B private onboard. Assigned: Mike Patel, Leo Rodrigues, Anya Volkov. ETA: initial eval results in 3 business days.

Mike Patel: action items (short):
- Leo: confirm infra sku + cost estimate (A10G vs A100) and staging plan.
- Anya: run safety/regression on s3://novapulse/evals/clinical_v1.tar.gz and post results to the ticket.
- Sara: confirm HSM addendum acceptance from customer and lock enablement call.
I'll draft the canary rollout doc and routing policy, include fallback to a smaller variant if safety fails.

Sara Chen: noted. I'll update CRM with the renewal risk note and schedule the enablement. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:

Leo Rodrigues: one more ops note: if the customer insists on A100s for both variants, estimate will be ~2x baseline; recommend offering a cheaper A10G canary first and a final A100 for prod only if metrics pass. :eyes:

Mike Patel: good point — will surface cost options in the rollout doc and include cost-vs-latency tradeoffs so CS can present to Novapulse.

Sara Chen: closing the loop for now — I'll post the enablement invite and the signed HSM addendum here once I have them. feel free to DM for anything urgent.
